workers_detected_count.description: Total number of unique worker persons detected in observation window.

helmet_compliance_ratio.description: Proportion of detected workers actively wearing a verified safety helmet. -1.0 if no workers present.

vest_compliance_ratio.description: Proportion of detected workers wearing a verified high-visibility safety vest. -1.0 if no workers present.

gloves_compliance_ratio.description: Proportion of detected workers wearing verified protective gloves. -1.0 if no workers present.

boots_compliance_ratio.description: Proportion of detected workers wearing verified safety boots. -1.0 if no workers present.

goggles_compliance_ratio.description: Proportion of detected workers wearing verified safety goggles/glasses. -1.0 if no workers present.

no_helmet_count.description: Detected workers explicitly missing safety helmets.

no_vest_count.description: Detected workers explicitly missing high-visibility safety vests.

no_gloves_count.description: Detected workers explicitly missing protective gloves.

no_boots_count.description: Detected workers explicitly missing safety footwear.

no_goggles_count.description: Detected workers explicitly missing safety goggles.

ppe_violations_count.description: Total detected PPE violations (missing helmet, vest, gloves, boots, goggles) in the window.

repeated_violations_count.description: Number of workers persisting with PPE non-compliance across multiple observation frames.

num_standing.description: Count of workers in neutral upright standing posture.

num_walking.description: Count of workers in walking / gait movement.

num_sitting.description: Count of workers in sitting posture.

num_squatting.description: Count of workers in squatting posture (knee angle < 115 deg).

num_kneeling.description: Count of workers kneeling (knee contact on ground).

num_bending.description: Count of workers with significant trunk flexion / stooping (torso angle >= 35 deg).

num_lying.description: Count of workers in horizontal / prone / supine position.

num_possible_fall.description: Count of workers detected with sudden fall motion or prone on ground level.

duration_sitting_sec.description: Max cumulative seconds spent in sitting posture by any observed worker.

duration_squatting_sec.description: Max cumulative seconds spent in squatting posture by any observed worker.

duration_kneeling_sec.description: Max cumulative seconds spent in kneeling posture by any observed worker.

duration_bending_sec.description: Max cumulative seconds spent in bending / stooping posture.

persistent_posture_events.description: Count of instances where an awkward posture was held continuously for > 10 seconds.

unsafe_zone_overlap.description: Maximum spatial overlap ratio between worker bounding box and configured hazard/no-go zones.

unsafe_zone_duration_sec.description: Total duration spent by any worker inside a configured unsafe zone.

hazard_proximity_indicator.description: 1 if a worker is proximate to active machinery or excavator, 0 otherwise.

num_detected_hazards.description: Count of heavy machinery, trucks, or excavators detected in the frame.

keypoint_conf_mean.description: Mean body keypoint detection confidence across all detected workers.

valid_frame_count.description: Total valid analyzed frames within the observation window.

observation_window_sec.description: Temporal span of the observation window.
